d:
Cyclone Arnab brings heavy rain, strong winds and high waves to Andhra Pradesh as the storm makes landfall along the coast. Several areas record extremely heavy rainfall, with more than 260 mm in parts of Anakapalli and Vizianagaram. Odisha remains on red alert for extremely heavy rain in Ganjam and Gajapati districts. Flights are cancelled, train services disrupted and evacuations stepped up, while the NDRF mobilises 39 teams for rescue and relief operations. High waves also lash the north Chennai coast.
Thank you for watching our video!
